cloudflare.title: Grindr blocks your requests
cloudflare.description: Cloudflare protecting the Grindr API is currently blocking your requests because of suspicious activity.
cloudflare.advice: You can also rotate request parameters using the button below.

network.title: Something blocked the request before it reached Grindr
network.description: A VPN, DNS filter, captive portal, or a school or work network may have answered instead of Grindr, or an edge in front of the Grindr API turned the request away.
network.advice: Otherwise, switch to another network, or rotate request parameters using the button below.

requestBlocked.vpnHint: If you use a VPN, try disabling it.
requestBlocked.dontShowAgain: Don't show again in this session
